meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按你给的时间范围去查会议，逐个取回纪要信息（含纪要文档、逐字稿链接），整理成结构化报告：单日输出会议概览，多日输出周报；你要求时还能生成或追加到云文档。没有纪要的会议会标注「无纪要」。
howto.when: 当你提到“整理会议纪要”、“生成会议周报”、“回顾会议内容”等需求时接管；未指定时间范围时默认过去 7 天。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 汇总本周会议，输出周报

say.text: 把过去 7 天的会议纪要生成一份云文档

howto.what_en: Claude queries meetings in a given date range, pulls each meeting's note info (doc and transcript links) and builds a structured report — a daily overview or a weekly digest — and can create a Lark doc on request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to organize meeting notes, build a meeting weekly report, or review meetings from a period. Defaults to the past 7 days if no range is given.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes
say_en.note: Summarizes this week's meetings into a weekly report

say_en.text: Show me which meetings happened today
Turn the past 7 days of meeting notes into a doc
